subject: Sponsor check-in: QR check-in flow & data reconciliation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, BadgeCo Support <support@badgeco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor check-in: QR check-in flow & data reconciliation

Hi Samantha and BadgeCo team,

Quick heads-up — during yesterday's onsite check-in we noticed ~7% of Acme attendees scanned the sponsor QR but never appeared in HubSpot with the opt-in flag set. That means some leads are not getting follow-up sequences.

What we need to triage:
- BadgeCo: can you share the raw scan logs for Acme's sponsor QR IDs from 2026-08-31 08:00 - 20:00 PST (event day)? CSV preferred.
- BadgeCo & Redwood: a field mapping between BadgeCo export column names and our HubSpot ingestion schema (particularly consent/opt-in, email, phone, event_id).
- Acme: confirmation of the opt-in language shown at the time of scan (or the public URL of the form).

I attached the sponsor QR sheet we sent to the booth team and BadgeCo's latest integration guide for context.

Immediate ask: please send logs and a proposed mapping by EOD tomorrow (Wed 9/2). If there are PII mismatches we should plan a short call Wed afternoon to agree on reconciliation steps.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142
From: BadgeCo Support <support@badgeco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor check-in: QR check-in flow & data reconciliation

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the flag. We've pulled the raw scan export for the Acme QR IDs you referenced — attaching a log extract (badgeco-scans-acme-20260831.csv) and a quick mapping table showing our column headers.

Preliminary notes:
- The majority of missing records are scans that only have badge ID + timestamp; the contact form submission did not complete in ~5% of cases (likely user dropped before entering email).
- We see a small number (~2%) where email parsing failed due to special characters; we'll include the raw bytes in the CSV for troubleshooting.

Attached: badgeco-scans-acme-20260831.csv; badgeco-integration-guide-v2.pdf

If you'd like, we can stand up an export that includes a single-use reconciliation key (recon_key) we add into the form payload so matches are deterministic.

Let us know the best time for a 30-min sync Wed 9/2 14:00–16:00 PST and we'll join.

— BadgeCo Support
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, BadgeCo Support <support@badgeco.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor check-in: QR check-in flow & data reconciliation

Jordan — thanks for flagging. Important for Acme that we can show consent proof for follow-up. A few points from our side:

- Our legal team requires the exact opt-in copy that appeared above the Submit button. If you can share the form URL or a screenshot, we can validate.
- We need the attendee list for all scanned users by 9/3 EOD to reconcile with our internal marketing CRM; a weekly export cadence after that would be ideal while you iron out the field mapping.
- If there are attendees with incomplete submissions, can we get an export that contains any available identifiers (badge_id, timestamp, device_id) so we can do fuzzy matches on our end?

Happy to join the Wed window — 15:00 PST works for me.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Partnerships — Acme Corporation
samantha.lee@acme.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, BadgeCo Support <support@badgeco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor check-in: QR check-in flow & data reconciliation

Thanks all — quick plan before the call (Wed 9/2 15:00 PST):

1) BadgeCo to share the full CSV (we have the extract) and enable a recon_key export. BadgeCo: confirm you can add recon_key for future exports (yes/no).
2) Redwood (Ben + Lauren) to draft a HubSpot ingestion mapping and a fallback reconciliation script for incomplete form submissions (fuzzy match on badge_id + timestamp window). Ben, Lauren — can you have the draft in Drive by 12:00 PST today? Link below.
3) Acme (Samantha) to confirm exact opt-in copy and whether Acme legal needs any export metadata.
4) If we confirm recon_key approach, we run a one-off reconciliation (48 hours) and then switch to daily exports for 7 days.

Attachments: acme-sponsor-qrcode-sheet.pdf (for reference)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_recon

Jordan
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor check-in: QR check-in flow & data reconciliation

On Wed, Sep 2, 2026 at 08:05 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) BadgeCo to share the full CSV (we have the extract) and enable a recon_key export. BadgeCo: confirm you can add recon_key for future exports (yes/no).

I'll take the mapping and the fallback script. I'll use the Drive folder Jordan created and commit a CSV->HubSpot mapping doc by 12:00 PST. I'll also add a short README explaining fuzzy-match thresholds (default: 10 minute window + badge_id partial).

Hannah
Field Ops Engineer — Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
